newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia annual CPI growth 1.3 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia annual CPI growth 1.3 pct in Q1.

text.p: The Australian consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.2 percent in the March quarter for an annual inflation rate of 1.3 percent, the Bureau of Statistics said.
The Treasury's measure of underlying inflation rose 0.4 percent in the March quarter to stand at 2.1 percent for the year.
In the December quarter, the CPI rose 0.2 percent for an annual inflation rate of 1.5 percent, while underlying inflation rose 0.4 percent for an annual 2.1 percent.
Main features (pct) March qtr/Dec qtr March qtr/March qtr
Most analysts had expected the March quarter CPI to rise by 0.1 percent for an annual rate of 1.2 percent, and underlying inflation to rise 0.4 percent for an annual 2.1 percent.

The bureau said contributing most to the increase in the quarter CPI were the cost of hospital and medical services, education fees, the prices of automotive fuel, domestic holiday travel and accommodation and entertainment services.
Partially offsetting these were falls in mortgage interest charges, down eight percent, the price of motor vehicles, overseas holiday travel and accommodation, fresh fruit and furniture.
The bureau said the 1.3 percent annual rise of the CPI was the lowest since the March quarter of 1993.
The CPI excluding housing rose 0.7 percent in the March quarter for an annual 2.5 percent.
